# Orbe Runner 3D

> Open-source 3D endless runner built from scratch with TypeScript and Three.js: recover the Star Fragments, dodge the Shadows and cross each Cycle. Plays in the browser on desktop and touch devices. The interface is in Spanish.

## Links

- [Play the game](https://orbe.naindev.com/): runs entirely in the browser
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/Orbe3D): TypeScript, Vite and Three.js with unit tests and design documents
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): the author's main site
